about: USAspending.gov is the official U.S. federal spending database. This CLI calls its public API (api.usaspending.gov, no auth needed) to search awards and transactions, open award, recipient, agency, state and federal-account profiles, break spending down by category, and request bulk downloads.

commands.summary: Keyword search of contract transactions (award types A/B/C/D), with sorting and paging

params.name: keyword
params.description: Free-text keyword to match in transaction and award text

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (max 100) (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)
